editorial:
Imagine being a total brainiac who hates the idea of dating, only to have the hottest guy on campus suddenly think you are his girlfriend. That is exactly what happens to Zoey, a smart computer student who just wants to focus on her grades. When Zack, the star soccer player, gets a bump on the head and loses his memory, he wakes up convinced that Zoey is the love of his life. The vibe is super light and sweet, making it the perfect pick if you want something that feels like a warm hug. It takes the classic fake-dating trope and adds a funny twist that keeps you smiling throughout the whole story.

You will really love how the chemistry between the two leads feels natural and cute. The pacing is steady, and while the plot is a bit predictable, the heart of the movie makes up for it. If you enjoy stories about opposites attracting, you should definitely give this a try. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp visuals, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical shelf is a great way to keep this feel-good story forever.
endingExplained: After spending time together, Zack eventually gets his memory back and remembers his actual girlfriend. However, he realizes that the connection he built with Zoey is much deeper and more honest than his old relationship. He breaks up with his former girlfriend and chooses to start a real romance with Zoey. They both learn to embrace their differences, and the movie ends with them happily together as a real couple.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves cute college romances and feel-good stories.
